title: Ruppelt's account of early UFO hypotheses

tellings.quote: And if you read Ruppelt's book on you know, the unexplained stuff that was going on then, he talks through how they go through all these hypotheses. It's like, is it human? Could it be Russian? Could it somehow be Nazi technology?

plain: In the early years of UFO reports, investigators worked through a list of explanations: was it human, was it Russian, could it "somehow be Nazi technology?" A researcher named Jason Simosa says this comes from the 1956 book The Report on Unidentified Flying Objects by Edward J. Ruppelt, who wrote about the Air Force's early UFO investigations. Simosa's point is that officials at the time seriously considered secret earthly origins before anything else.
